## Summary
Briefly explain *what* this PR changes and *why*.

## Related Issue
Closes #

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat/` — New feature or enhancement
- [ ] `fix/` — Bug fix
- [ ] `docs/` — Documentation or workflow updates
- [ ] `security/` — Security patch or dependency hardening

## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] Branch name follows `feat/...`, `fix/...`, `docs/...`, or `security/...`
- [ ] Commits are small, single-purpose, and follow the `<type>: <imperative summary>` convention
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` files, generated artifacts, or local editor state are included
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Local tests/linters pass and the repository remains in an understandable state
